label: 가진 금화를 모두 쌓아 과시한다
label_en: Pile up all your gold and show it off
success_text_en: The crowd cheers and chants your name.
fail_text_en: Your pile is smaller than expected, and you earn only laughter.

label: 후보에서 사양한다
success_text_en: You hear whispers calling you 'a fool with no hunger.'

label: 성대한 만찬을 열어 초대한다
label_en: Throw a lavish feast and invite them
success_text: 배불리 먹은 젊은이들이 그 자리에서 입교합니다.
success_text_en: Stuffed and happy, the youths join on the spot.
fail_text_en: They eat everything and leave.

label: 소박한 죽 한 그릇을 권한다
label_en: Offer a humble bowl of porridge
success_text_en: Everyone is disappointed, but your heart is calm.

label: 기꺼이 설교한다
success_text_en: He hands over a fat purse as promised.

label: 이자를 두 배로 올리라고 부추긴다
label_en: Urge him to double his rates
success_text_en: Moved, he adds even more to his offering.
fail_text_en: Debtors swarm your temple in protest.

label: 거절하고 빚을 탕감하라 권한다
label_en: Refuse and urge him to forgive debts
success_text_en: He scoffs and spreads word of your 'pauper god.'

label: 금으로 된 의자를 주문한다
success_text: 번쩍이는 권좌에 앉자 모두가 고개를 숙입니다.
success_text_en: As you sit on the gleaming throne, all heads bow.
fail_text_en: The chair collapses and you lose face.

label: 낮은 자리에 앉는 이유를 설명한다
success_text: 신도들은 고개를 갸웃하지만 당신은 흔들리지 않습니다.
success_text_en: Followers tilt their heads, but you remain unshaken.

label: 야망의 장을 집필한다
success_text_en: Your sharp prose wins acclaim among scholars.
fail_text_en: Critics call your logic sloppy.

label: 절제의 주석을 몰래 끼워 넣는다
label_en: Sneak in a footnote on temperance
success_text: 아무도 눈치채지 못한 채 진리가 한 줄 남습니다.
success_text_en: A line of truth survives, unnoticed by all.
fail_text_en: You're caught and branded a heretic.

label: 경쟁을 공식 행사로 만든다
label_en: Make the contest an official event
success_text_en: The rivalry becomes a festival everyone enjoys.
fail_text_en: The losers leave holding grudges.

label: 재산을 나누라고 설득한다
label_en: Persuade them to share their wealth
success_text_en: Surprisingly, a few begin sharing.
fail_text_en: You're mocked as 'the leader who spreads poverty.'

label: 내버려 둔다
success_text_en: The fight fades on its own, but resentment lingers.

label: 비단옷을 입고 행차한다
success_text_en: Your dazzling procession changes the look in their eyes.
fail_text_en: The silk tears and you become a laughingstock.

label: 누더기를 입고 설교한다
success_text_en: Followers are let down, though a few shed tears.

label: 욕망을 받아들인다
success_text: 가슴 속 불꽃이 타오르며 확신이 생깁니다.
success_text_en: A flame flares in your chest, bringing conviction.

label: 거울을 덮고 명상한다
success_text: 고요 속에서 신의 목소리를 다시 듣습니다.
success_text_en: In the silence, you hear the divine voice again.
fail_text_en: The whispering does not stop all night.

label: 시인에게 돈을 주고 노래를 바꾼다
label_en: Pay the bard to change the song
success_text: 새 노래에서 당신은 탐욕의 영웅이 됩니다.
success_text_en: In the new song, you become a hero of greed.
fail_text_en: The bard pockets the money and vanishes.

label: 노래를 따라 부르며 웃어넘긴다
label_en: Sing along and laugh it off
success_text_en: Your unexpected ease wins people over.
fail_text_en: You only look more ridiculous.

label: 야망을 부추기며 받아들인다
label_en: Accept them and fan their ambition
success_text_en: They become a loyal guard.
fail_text_en: They stir up power struggles and sour the mood.

label: 겸손을 배우라고 충고한다
success_text: 그들은 비웃으며 떠나고 한 명만 남습니다.
success_text_en: They laugh and leave; only one stays.

label: 경쟁 교단에 소개한다
label_en: Refer them to a rival cult
success_text: 다들 당신이 사람 볼 줄 안다고 말합니다.
success_text_en: People say you have an eye for talent.

label: 즉시 도입한다
success_text_en: The donation box overflows, but those in back grumble.

label: 경매로 자리를 판다
success_text_en: The fierce bidding draws curious crowds.
fail_text_en: Followers come to blows.

label: 자리는 평등해야 한다고 말한다
success_text_en: A few wealthy followers are displeased.

label: 대담한 확장 계획을 발표한다
success_text_en: The council applauds and hands you the key.
fail_text_en: You're dismissed as a braggart.

label: 참가하지 않는다
success_text_en: Your silence is read as a concession.

label: 교묘한 궤변으로 답한다
success_text_en: The student marvels and copies it everywhere.
fail_text_en: Someone points out the contradiction, and you're cornered.

label: 정직이 죄가 아니라고 답한다
label_en: Answer that honesty is no sin
success_text: 학생은 충격을 받고 그 소문이 퍼집니다.
success_text_en: The student is shocked, and the rumor spreads.

label: 가장 크게 외친 자에게 준다
label_en: Give it to whoever shouts loudest
success_text: 한바탕 소동 끝에 모두 웃음을 터뜨립니다.
success_text_en: After a ruckus, everyone bursts out laughing.
fail_text_en: The shouting turns into a brawl.

label: 당신이 먹어 버린다
success_text: 교주의 식탐에 다들 경외 반 원망 반입니다.
success_text_en: Your gluttony earns half awe, half resentment.

label: 고기를 잘게 나눈다
success_text_en: Everyone smiles sheepishly over their tiny bites.
fail_text_en: Rumors call your cult miserly.

label: 공개적으로 꾸짖어 본보기로 삼는다
label_en: Rebuke them publicly as an example
success_text: 신도들이 욕망의 가르침을 더 굳게 믿습니다.
success_text_en: Followers hold even tighter to the teaching of desire.
fail_text_en: Cries that you're too harsh grow louder.

label: 조용히 간호해 준다
success_text: 신도는 눈물로 감사하며 더 깊이 따릅니다.
success_text_en: The follower weeps with gratitude and follows you more deeply.

label: 아끼는 보석을 바친다
success_text: 제단 위 보석이 빛나며 응답이 옵니다.
success_text_en: The jewel glows on the altar, and an answer comes.

label: 신도의 재물을 대신 바친다
success_text_en: You feel as if your god is laughing.
fail_text_en: Followers grow resentful, and the god is silent.

label: 계시를 해석만 하고 미룬다
success_text_en: The divine voice grows a little more distant.

label: 더 크게 부패를 자랑한다
label_en: Boast even louder about your corruption
success_text: 군중은 당신의 솔직한 탐욕에 박수를 보냅니다.
success_text_en: The crowd applauds your candid greed.
fail_text_en: You're mocked for baseless bluster.

label: 청렴을 당당히 인정한다
success_text_en: People click their tongues, but your conscience is clear.

label: 열두 코스 요리를 대접한다
success_text_en: Moved, the gourmand brings their own admirers too.
fail_text_en: The food goes cold and draws harsh reviews.

label: 맛은 혀가 아닌 마음에 있다고 말한다
label_en: Say taste lives in the heart, not the tongue
success_text: 미식가는 고개를 젓지만 몇몇 신학자가 관심을 보입니다.
success_text_en: The gourmand shakes their head, but some theologians take interest.

label: 곡식을 비싸게 판다
label_en: Sell them grain at a steep price
success_text_en: People praise you as 'a shrewd trader.'

label: 곡식을 무료로 나눈다
success_text: 이웃들은 비웃지만 이재민 몇은 고개 숙여 감사합니다.
success_text_en: Neighbors sneer, though a few of the displaced bow in thanks.

label: 신도로 입교하면 준다고 한다
label_en: Offer grain only to those who join
success_text_en: The hungry hurry to join.
fail_text_en: You're blasted for exploiting the weak.

label: 서열제를 도입하고 정점에 선다
label_en: Adopt it and stand at the top
success_text_en: Everyone lines up beneath you.
fail_text_en: Rank disputes throw things into chaos.

label: 측근에게 맡긴다
label_en: Leave it to your right hand
success_text_en: Your aide's influence grows, but the mood stays calm.

label: 불태우고 의식을 연다
success_text_en: Followers cheer before the flames.

label: 몰래 해독한다
success_text: 잊힌 지혜가 당신의 교리를 깊게 합니다.
success_text_en: Forgotten wisdom deepens your doctrine.
fail_text_en: Once caught, you're branded a 'virtue worshipper.'

label: 셋이 함께 살라고 권한다
success_text_en: The daring solution makes everyone laugh and reconcile.
fail_text_en: It spirals into an even bigger drama of jealousy.

label: 연인 본인에게 선택을 맡긴다
success_text_en: The choice hurts, but the uproar settles.

label: 공개적으로 사치스러운 잔치를 연다
success_text_en: Doubts melt away in a night of revelry.
fail_text_en: You overdrink and make a scene.

label: 당신의 수행을 솔직히 고백한다
success_text_en: Some leave, but those who stay grow steadfast.

label: 더 큰 욕망이 있다고 답한다
success_text: 노인은 웃으며 당신에게 길을 비켜 줍니다.
success_text_en: The old man smiles and steps aside for you.

label: 함께 밤새 이야기를 나눈다
label_en: Talk with him through the night
success_text_en: By dawn, your faith feels newly solid.
fail_text_en: You find no answer and return exhausted.

label: 황금 첨탑을 세운다
success_text_en: Your rank shoots up overnight.
fail_text_en: Construction stalls, leaving only an eyesore.

label: 기자에게 뇌물을 준다
success_text_en: In the next issue, you're near the top.
fail_text_en: The bribe is exposed in print as too stingy.

label: 무시한다
success_text_en: Your rank stays, but your mind is at ease.

label: 부를 약속하며 모두 받는다
label_en: Promise wealth and take them all
success_text: 신도 수가 크게 늘지만 믿음은 얕습니다.
success_text_en: Your numbers swell, though their faith runs shallow.
fail_text_en: They riot, demanding you keep your promise.

label: 시험을 거쳐 일부만 받는다
label_en: Admit only those who pass a test
success_text_en: Fewer, but trustworthy, people join.

label: 교단 금고를 전부 건다
success_text: 돈이 정말 두 배가 되어 돌아옵니다.
success_text_en: The money really comes back doubled.
fail_text_en: The scheme vanishes and the treasury takes a heavy hit.

label: 조금만 걸어 본다
success_text_en: You turn a modest profit.
fail_text_en: You lose a bit, but it doesn't hurt much.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: There's talk of 'the coward leader.'

label: 끌어내리고 권위를 세운다
label_en: Pull them down and assert authority
success_text_en: Everyone remembers who's in charge.
fail_text_en: Followers think you petty.

label: 후계자로 키운다
success_text_en: A new voice brings life to the doctrine.

label: 명제를 강하게 옹호한다
success_text_en: The audience cheers your fiery speech.
fail_text_en: You stumble and get rebutted.

label: 천천히 반론을 편다
success_text_en: Your persistent reasoning silences the hall.
fail_text_en: You're drowned out by jeers of boredom.

label: '포식의 밤'으로 정한다
success_text_en: Everyone pats their bellies, united.

label: '황금 가면무도회'로 정한다
success_text_en: Behind masks, followers grow closer.
fail_text_en: Behind the masks, only gossip flows.

label: '침묵의 날'로 정한다
success_text_en: Followers are bored, but you are at peace.

label: 가장 큰 야망을 외치게 한다
label_en: Have them shout their greatest ambition
success_text_en: Parents are moved by the young people's roar.
fail_text_en: A few hesitate, and the mood cools.

label: 욕망 대신 다짐을 말하게 한다
label_en: Have them speak a vow instead
success_text_en: Parents complain, but the young eyes are clear.

label: 진미를 모두 먹는다
success_text_en: After eating, your strength surges.
fail_text_en: Your illness worsens.

label: 의원의 말을 따른다
success_text_en: Followers are hurt, but your body recovers.

label: 가장 대담한 욕망을 자랑한다
success_text_en: The nobles name you the talk of the season.
fail_text_en: You cross a line and are shown the door.

label: 조용히 술잔만 기울인다
success_text_en: No one remembers you.

label: 군중에 합류해 연설한다
label_en: Join the crowd and give a speech
success_text_en: The crowd follows you as its leader.
fail_text_en: It turns into a riot and you take the blame.

label: 수도사들을 숨겨 준다
success_text_en: Two monks thank you and quietly join.

label: 그의 탐욕을 칭찬하고 몫을 나눈다
label_en: Praise his greed and split the take
success_text: 그는 충성을 맹세하며 더 많이 벌어 오겠다고 합니다.
success_text_en: He swears loyalty and promises to bring in more.

label: 조사해 되찾는다
success_text_en: The gold is recovered and order restored.
fail_text: 증거를 못 찾아 신도끼리 의심만 커집니다.
fail_text_en: No proof turns up, and suspicion spreads.

label: 영주를 위협해 역으로 굴복시킨다
success_text_en: The lord kneels before you.
fail_text_en: In retaliation, followers are dragged away.

label: 조공을 바치고 자율을 얻는다
success_text_en: It costs money, but your independence holds.

label: 굴복한다
success_text: 영주의 비호 아래 헌금은 늘지만 권위는 바닥입니다.
success_text_en: Under his protection offerings grow, but your authority hits bottom.

label: 교리에 넣는다
success_text_en: The dining table becomes a holy altar.

label: 여섯 끼로 늘린다
success_text_en: The radical precept becomes the talk of the city.
fail_text_en: Followers fall ill one after another.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: The petitioners grumble in disappointment.

label: 재산 순으로 방을 배정한다
success_text_en: Wealthy followers are pleased, but a rift opens.

label: 모두에게 같은 방을 준다
success_text_en: Unexpectedly, they begin to mingle.
fail_text_en: People sneer at your 'commune cult.'

label: 소문을 키우고 축복식을 연다
label_en: Fuel the rumor and hold a blessing rite
success_text: 마침 한 신도가 횡재해 믿음이 폭발합니다.
success_text_en: One follower happens to strike it rich, and faith explodes.
fail_text: 아무도 부자가 되지 않아 실망이 퍼집니다.
fail_text_en: No one gets rich, and disappointment spreads.

label: 소문을 부정한다
success_text_en: Followers are let down but still trust you.

label: 금으로 덮는다
success_text_en: Prayers grow fervent before the shining statue.

label: 그대로 두고 기도한다
success_text: 소박한 돌 앞에서 오히려 신이 가깝게 느껴집니다.
success_text_en: Before the plain stone, the god feels closer.
fail_text_en: Visitors whisper that it looks shabby.

label: 대담한 거짓말로 참가한다
success_text_en: Your lie wins first prize.
fail_text_en: You're booed for a lie that's too obvious.

label: 진실을 말해 관객을 당황시킨다
label_en: Tell the truth and baffle the audience
success_text: 아무도 믿지 않아 오히려 최고의 거짓말로 뽑힙니다.
success_text_en: No one believes it, so it's voted the best lie.
fail_text_en: They call you boring.

label: 교단 행사의 무대를 맡긴다
label_en: Give her the stage at cult events
success_text_en: Her fans join in droves.
fail_text_en: Conservative followers push back.

label: 명상반에 넣는다
label_en: Put her in the meditation class
success_text_en: Surprisingly, she falls in love with stillness.
fail_text_en: She leaves bored and badmouths you.

label: 값을 세 배로 올린다
success_text_en: The pricier it gets, the better it sells.
fail_text_en: Sales drop amid cries of price gouging.

label: 가난한 이에게 무료로 나눈다
label_en: Give some free to the poor
success_text: 상인들은 비웃지만 거리 곳곳에 부적이 걸립니다.
success_text_en: Merchants scoff, but charms hang on every street.

label: 장로회를 해산한다
success_text_en: The cult now moves at your will.
fail_text_en: The elders walk out, taking followers with them.

label: 표결을 받아들인다
success_text_en: Slower, but everyone takes part in decisions.

label: 장로들을 금으로 매수한다
label_en: Buy off the elders with gold
success_text_en: The council falls silent.
fail_text_en: The bribery comes out and trust collapses.

label: 탐욕의 철학서를 새로 쓴다
label_en: Write a new treatise on greed
success_text_en: The envoy takes the book back home.
fail_text_en: You write all night but produce a dud.

label: 깊이는 비움에서 온다고 답한다
label_en: Reply that depth comes from emptiness
success_text_en: The envoy leaves bewildered.

label: 함께 뛰논다
success_text_en: Laughter fills the whole cult.

label: 빗물을 모아 팔자고 한다
label_en: Suggest bottling the rainwater to sell
success_text_en: The 'holy water' trade does well.
fail_text_en: Everyone sulks that you killed the mood.

label: 공개 만찬에서 폭식한다
success_text_en: The suspicion vanishes completely.
fail_text_en: You get sick midway and deepen the doubt.

label: 수행 사실을 인정한다
success_text_en: A few followers leave, but you stand upright.

label: 왕좌를 노린다고 대놓고 말한다
label_en: Openly declare you covet the throne
success_text: 왕이 크게 웃으며 당신을 총신으로 삼습니다.
success_text_en: The king laughs heartily and makes you a favorite.
fail_text_en: You're flogged for insolence.

label: 교단의 성장만 말한다
label_en: Speak only of your cult's growth
success_text: 왕은 고개를 끄덕이며 작은 상을 내립니다.
success_text_en: The king nods and grants a modest reward.

label: 교단 안에 도박장을 연다
label_en: Open a gambling hall inside the cult
success_text_en: Even the gamblers' friends come flocking.
fail_text_en: A debt dispute ends in a knife fight.

label: 도박을 끊는 조건으로 받는다
label_en: Accept them on condition they quit
success_text_en: A few really do turn over a new leaf.
fail_text_en: They all laugh and leave.

label: 거절한다
success_text_en: They head to a rival cult.

label: 거울 속 자신에게 말을 건다
success_text: 그는 당신이 감춰 둔 갈망을 하나하나 짚어 줍니다.
success_text_en: It names, one by one, the cravings you've hidden.
fail_text_en: Only mocking laughter echoes back.

label: 거울을 깨뜨린다
success_text_en: Your hand bleeds, but your heart feels lighter.

label: 끝까지 기도를 이어 간다
success_text: 결국 거울 속 당신도 다시 두 손을 모읍니다.
success_text_en: In the end, your reflection folds its hands again.
fail_text: 거울 속 웃음이 밤새 멈추지 않습니다.
fail_text_en: Your reflection keeps smiling all night.
